title: GTA+
headline: GTA+
subtitle: This Month’s Benefits
content:
In addition to the recurring monthly GTA$500,000 deposited directly into your Maze Bank account, GTA+ Members who've signed up for this month (November 5–December 9) will also receive:

— The Grotti Itali RSX (Sports)
— The Sod Off Mansion Decoration
— 2X GTA$ and RP on Import/Export Sell Missions
— The Pop Art Revere Collar shirt
— 60% off Warehouses and Vehicle Warehouses
— And more

Membership automatically renews monthly, cancel anytime. Visit rsg.ms/gtaplus for more info.
